scientific_integrity: A universal representation-theoretic proof and explicit rational dual inequalities establish the theorem; finite exact and numerical tests corroborate. The same-model assessment is not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only central mixtures of classes moving at most four letters; no cost constraint, noncentral sampling optimization, or uniqueness of optimal laws is established. Historical priority remains provisional because relevant classwise records were available only as summaries.
title: Optimal short-cycle Fourier sampling on symmetric groups: a tight four-point exception and sharp higher-rank barriers
